reading: Joined by the term Cart: BigCommerce's Carts API, 'Create and manage server-side carts using BigCommerce cart logic' (BC-S-0082), is the buyer's cart as Shopify's carts/create (SH-S-6066) and Salla's API folder Cart (SA-S-1080) show it. Every statement of the concern (BC-S-0082 to BC-S-0086) is cited in CM-CHK-002; its plan line Persistent cart (BC-S-0084) is kept in this capability (notes). A reading.

Joined by the term Abandoned carts, Salla's (and Zid's) name: BigCommerce's webhook topic store/cart/abandoned defines an abandoned cart as one with no changes 'for at least one hour after the last modified property' (BC-S-0091), against Salla's Merchant API folder Abandoned Carts (SA-S-1035). Strained: the concern's recovery statements, the Abandoned cart saver plan line (BC-S-0090), its setting (BC-S-0089), the Abandoned Cart Emails API (BC-S-0088), the abandoned cart token from the email link (BC-S-0087) and the product line Abandoned cart recovery (BC-I-0501), are cited as core in domain D's CM-MKT-022 (Abandoned cart and order recovery) by D-bigcommerce, and by 'One thing, one domain' are left there. A reading.

Joined by the term Checkout: BigCommerce's control panel page Settings > Checkout (BC-S-0094), with its Checkouts API, 'Create and manage checkouts from existing carts using BigCommerce checkout logic' (BC-S-0092), against Shopify's settings page Checkout (SH-S-1489) and Salla's dashboard link Checkout (SA-S-1685). Its Custom Checkout choice, its scope Checkout Content (BC-S-0098) and its responsibility statement on modifications to the checkout environment (BC-S-0096) are cited in the child CM-CHK-003, in the same tree. A reading.

Joined by the term Checkout Extensions, which Shopify's cell holds: BigCommerce's Beta Checkout Extensions, where 'our partner Route has created a checkout extension to extend the shipping step on the checkout page' (BC-S-0101), is an app's addition to the checkout as Shopify's 'build an app with extensions to augment Shopify checkout' (SH-S-0679) is. It is in closed beta (BC-S-0077, scope Checkout Extensions (closed beta)). A reading.

Joined by the term Orders: BigCommerce's product line Order management, 'Manage orders from every channel in a single location' (BC-S-0105), with its Orders V2 API (BC-S-0103), against Shopify's admin navigation item Orders (SH-S-1507) and Salla's dashboard link Orders (SA-S-1691). It is the parent: its statements are also cited in the children order editing (CM-ORD-002), statuses (CM-ORD-003), orders the merchant creates (CM-ORD-005) and notes (CM-ORD-013). Its app category Catalog & Order Management (BC-I-0480) is also cited in B's CM-CAT-001 and F's CM-APP-002, as extension-point; that is an inventory entry, not a statement, so the fit is kept clean. A reading. Strained, by the dry run's S1 (the coordinator, after batch 3): BC-S-0103, an order's products, shipping addresses, messages and shipments, is also cited in CM-SHP-009 under BC-C-019's key, in the CM-SHP-001 tree.

Joined by the term Transactions: BigCommerce's scope store_v2_transactions, 'Order Transactions … View and modify order transactions' (BC-S-0114), and its Transactions API, which records payments processed externally so that merchants can 'use BigCommerce for post-order actions such as capture, void, and refund' (BC-S-0111), are an order's payment transactions, as Shopify's webhook topic order_transactions/create (SH-S-1292) and Salla's API folder Transactions (SA-S-1058) are. Every statement of the concern is cited in CM-PAY-020, a child of CM-ORD-001. The refunds BC-S-0111 names are RET's, for batch 3 (notes). A reading.

Joined by definition: BigCommerce's Payments API, 'Charge customers and process refunds through BigCommerce's PCI-compliant Payments server using supported payment gateways' (BC-S-0121), where a gateway configured for authorization only needs the order captured later 'using the control panel or the Capture API' (BC-S-0125), is authorizing and capturing an order's payment, as Shopify's setting to capture automatically or manually (SH-S-0390) and Salla's endpoint to refund, void or reverse a transaction (SA-S-0180) are. Strained: its 3D Secure statement, that a card 'must first be saved during a shopper-initiated transaction and then charged as a stored payment instrument' (BC-S-0130), is cited in CM-PAY-022 (its own tree), and its statement that the API does not process 'offline payment methods (Help Center) such as cash on delivery' (BC-S-0129) in CM-PAY-016 and CM-PAY-029, and its list of compatible payment gateways (BC-S-0124) in CM-PAY-011, all in the CM-PAY-001 tree. The API's 'BigCommerce Payments Gateway' (BC-S-0123) is the API's server, not the product BigCommerce Payments (BC-C-025): homonym, notes. A reading.

Joined by the term Payment methods: BigCommerce's Payment Methods API, 'Retrieve the payment methods a store accepts' (BC-S-0131), with its scope store_payments_methods_read (BC-S-0133), is the store's accepted payment methods, as Salla's admin link Payment methods (SA-S-1875) and Shopify's statement that the buyer pays with any method the merchant activated (SH-S-0319) are. No control panel page for payments is held (Q1's gaps BC-C-023/responsible stated only in general terms, reason searched, not found). A reading.

Joined by definition: BigCommerce's Stored Instruments API, where one can 'create, modify, list, and delete stored instruments, as well as set default stored payment instruments for a given customer' (BC-S-0134), its vaulting feature (BC-S-0136), scope (BC-S-0137), webhook topic (BC-S-0138) and payments server for 'attaching an instrument to a customer' (BC-S-0139), are payment methods the store keeps for a customer, as Shopify's payment methods to pay future orders without checkout (SH-S-0592), its route pay-order-by-vaulted (SH-S-5225), and WooCommerce's Payment Token API (WC-S-0943) are; that the store charges them without the buyer at checkout rests on BC-C-022's BC-S-0130. Strained: the API's purpose, 'save credit cards, bank accounts, and PayPal accounts for a faster checkout experience' (BC-S-0134), and the plan line Stored credit cards, where returning customers' billing and shipping are 'automatically filled to save time at checkout' (BC-S-0135), are also cited in CM-PAY-014, in the tree of CM-CHK-008, and BC-S-0134's PayPal accounts in CM-PAY-013, in the CM-PAY-001 tree. A reading.

Joined on role: BigCommerce Payments, 'a native experience where your payments data lives alongside your orders and payouts in one place' (BC-S-0149), with balance and payouts reported 'natively inside your BigCommerce admin through the Money Dashboard' (BC-S-0141), is the payment service of the platform itself, the role Shopify Payments, 'an integrated payment gateway offered by Shopify' (SH-S-0325), and Salla Payments, a service Salla offers to process payments in the store (SA-S-0049), have. The names differ, and no held statement names BigCommerce's company as its maker or provider: the brand in the name doesn't (Q1's gap BC-C-025/responsible, page not read). Its statements are cited in CM-PAY-002 and its children CM-PAY-004, CM-PAY-005 and CM-PAY-007, and in CM-PAY-011, all in the CM-PAY-001 tree. A reading.

Joined by the terms payment providers and payment gateways: BigCommerce's 'more than 65 pre-integrated online payment solutions' (BC-S-0150), its Embedded and Open Payment Providers, and 'the store's connected payment gateways' (BC-S-0160), are the providers the merchant connects to take payments, as Shopify's route Third-party payment providers (SH-S-7114) and Salla's other gateways (SA-S-0069) are. The Embedded Payment Provider List also names BigCommerce Payments (BC-S-0142, BC-I-0435), which is CM-PAY-002's. Strained: its Open Payment Provider Fee, the platform's fee on orders through Open Payment Providers (BC-S-0154, BC-I-0423), is cited as core in domain A's CM-PLN-003 (Platform fee on the merchant's sales) by A-bigcommerce, and by 'One thing, one domain' its other fee statements (BC-S-0152, BC-S-0153, BC-S-0158, BC-S-0159) are left to that cell (notes); its app category Financing (BC-I-0486) is cited in CM-PAY-026, its own tree. A reading.

Joined by the terms Digital wallets, Salla's (المحافظ الرقمية), and Apple Pay, Google Pay and Amazon Pay, Shopify's: BigCommerce's plan line 'Apple Pay, Google Pay, and Amazon Pay' (BC-S-0162) and its product line Digital wallets (BC-S-0161) are third-party wallets the buyer pays with, as Shopify's Apple Pay (SH-S-0025) and Salla's plan line Apple Pay (SA-S-1962) are. Strained: BC-S-0161, 'with accelerated checkout options', is cited as core in CM-CHK-008 (batch 1), in the CHK tree. A reading. BC-S-0164 is also cited in CM-SHP-013, in the CM-SHP-001 tree (the coordinator, after batch 3).

Joined on role: B2B Edition's 'Invoicing & net terms Support invoices, net terms, credit limits, and B2B purchasing workflows' (BC-S-0194), with its API 'for Invoices, Payments, and Receipts' (BC-S-0192), is paying after the purchase on terms the merchant sets, the role of Shopify's Payment terms, with its permission Set payment terms (SH-S-7152) and webhook topic payment_schedules/due (SH-S-6081). The names differ (net terms, payment terms), and neither statement says what B2B Edition's invoices are for, nor ties them to an order: CM-ORD-008 stays none-held (notes). Strained: its Payments API, enabling and disabling payment methods 'on a Company-to-Company basis' (BC-S-0193, BC-S-0195), is cited in CM-PAY-019, in the CM-PAY-001 tree; and its scope store_b2b_manage (BC-S-0196) is held under D's BC-C-065 too and cited as core in D's CM-B2B-001 and CM-B2B-004. Its credit limits are the business buyer's, not CM-PAY-025's credit to the merchant (homonym, notes). A reading.

Joined by the terms Tax settings and tax rates: BigCommerce's Tax API, to 'Manage tax configuration for your store, including tax classes, tax properties, tax zones, tax rates, and tax settings' (BC-S-0383), with its Tax settings for 'how a store handles tax calculation and price display' (BC-S-0384), is the store's tax settings and the rates it charges, as Salla's dashboard link Tax settings (SA-S-1879) and Shopify's settings section Taxes and duties (SH-S-1492) are. Its statements are cited in CM-TAX-001 and its child CM-TAX-004. A reading.

Joined by the term tax provider: BigCommerce's Tax Provider API, 'to integrate a tax calculation engine into the BigCommerce storefront and control panel' (BC-S-0388), which 'works in conjunction with a BigCommerce app' (BC-S-0390), is a third party calculating the store's taxes, as Shopify's route Manage tax provider (SH-S-7127) and its tax app that replaces Shopify's tax service (SH-S-0530) are. Strained: its app category Accounting & Tax (BC-I-0476), which names accounting too, is cited in CM-PAY-028, its own tree (and in F's CM-APP-002 by F-bigcommerce). A reading.

Joined by the term in-store pickup: BigCommerce's Pickup Methods API, 'pickup methods that define how customers can collect their orders, such as in-store pickup or curbside delivery' (BC-S-0044), and its product line Buy online, pick up in store (BC-S-0045), are the buyer collecting the order at the store, as Shopify's route Pickup in store (SH-S-7137) and WooCommerce's Local pickup (WC-S-0291) show it. Curbside delivery is named as a pickup method, so it stays here, not in CM-SHP-008. Strained: the concern's statement on partner solutions as the source of truth for locations and inventories (BC-S-0047) is cited as outside in domain B's CM-INV-001 and CM-INV-005 by B-bigcommerce, and is not cited here: it names locations and inventory, not pickup. A reading.

Joined by the terms Shipments and Order Fulfillment: the webhook topic store/shipment/created (BC-S-0110) and the scope store_order_fulfillment_manage, 'View and modify order fulfillments' (BC-S-0109), are an order's shipments and fulfillments as Salla's order.shipment.created (SA-S-1579) and Shopify's API object FulfillmentOrder (SH-S-0921) show them. Strained: the Orders V2 group's statement, which names 'shipments, and shipping address quotes' with an order's coupons, messages, products, statuses and taxes (BC-S-0103), is cited here under this concern's key and in the CM-ORD-001 tree (CM-ORD-001, CM-ORD-002, CM-ORD-003, CM-ORD-013) under BC-C-018's. A reading.

Joined by the term shipping zones: 'You can configure shipping zones in the control panel or use the API to designate where a merchant ships their products and with which shipping methods' (BC-S-0378), with the Shipping V2 API's 'shipping zones, shipping methods, and shipping carrier connections' (BC-S-0374) and the page Settings > Setup > Shipping (BC-S-0375), against Salla's Merchant API folder Shipping Zones (SA-S-1046) and WooCommerce's section Shipping zones (WC-S-0017). Every statement of the concern is in the CM-SHP-001 tree: its plan line Real-time shipping quotes (BC-S-0377) in CM-SHP-004, its ShipperHQ plan line (BC-I-0410) in the new CM-SHP-023, the carrier connections in CM-SHP-015. Its app category Shipping & Fulfillment (BC-I-0495) is an inventory entry also cited in F's CM-APP-002 as extension-point, and the fit is kept clean, as batch 1 did for BC-I-0480. A reading.

Joined by definition: the Shipping Providers specification 'describes API requests BigCommerce will make to a registered shipping carrierʼs server to check connection options and retrieve rates' (BC-S-0381), so the rates the buyer sees are calculated by the carrier's server, as Shopify's plan line 3rd-party calculated shipping rates (SH-S-7048) and WooCommerce's plugins adding 'their own rates' through the Shipping Method API (WC-S-0628) show. All the concern's statements are in CM-SHP-004. Its term Shipping Providers is WooCommerce's term in CM-SHP-015 (the settings section Shipping > Shipping providers, WC-S-0020); I landed it by definition here, since its statements are the rates a carrier's server returns, and cite BC-S-0381's registered carrier as shows in CM-SHP-015 (notes). A reading.

Joined by the term Refund: 'You can issue a refund using the store control panel (Help Center), the Refunds API, or through the payment gateway directly' (BC-S-0119), with the topic store/order/refund/created (BC-S-0118) and Order V3's refunds against orders with settled payments (BC-S-0120), against Shopify's API object Refund (SH-S-0932). Its product line Refunds & returns (BC-S-0117) is cited in the parent CM-RET-001, Salla's إدارة طلبات الاسترجاع الجزئي والكلي (SA-S-1998), and as shows in CM-RET-003; all in the CM-RET-001 tree, under CM-ORD-001. A reading.
